name: Corte And Cut Beauty Salon
hours: Mon 10 AM–7 PM; Tue 10 AM–7 PM; Wed 10 AM–7 PM; Thu 10 AM–7 PM; Fri 10 AM–7 PM; Sat 10 AM–7 PM; Sun Closed

reviews.t: Hands down best fade in WNC. Polite and kind and I will wait 90minutes with a smile on my face knowing i’m going to look good when i get out that chair. I don’t speak spanish and i’m always treated wonderfully. Sonya is the best !!!

Everyone I encountered was incredibly kind and welcoming. From the moment I arrived until the time I left, the entire experience was positive and pleasant. The staff went out of their way to make sure everything went smoothly, and their friendly attitude made a big difference.

Took a chance and went into the shop this afternoon for a haircut. First, very clean shop, personable and friendly staff. Watched as both stylists took their time and attention to give clients before me great cuts. When it was my turn we discussed what I was looking for - wow! I left with a fabulous cut and style and feeling like a new woman! Will definitely be getting my cut there again.

My toddler had his first haircut here and they were so friendly and took their time with him. His hair looked so cute afterward!! Updating this post to say that my husband and two boys go here regularly and their hair always looks great afterward. We’ve been regulars for over a year now. We love this local spot!! ❤️
She is the best ! I highly recommend this place for fades. She makes you feel 1st class.
I was a walk in and she did a great cut for 25.00, I Will be going back to this Salon. Awesome job on my bangs!
Got a great haircut (that I've been enjoying) and she called me back to get my daughter in later that day. Great service.
Iv been taking my soon here for years. They are very nice and do an amazing job

Cut and dyed my daughters hair. She's so happy with it. Employees are kind and hospitable.
